description: Call this when you want to check the MCP servers in your config or a list of hosts. Free. Same report as POST /v1/dependency-watch/report: up to 50 hosts or an mcp.json. Each server comes back with its last handshake, tool count, tools-hash change date and receipt link. Then watch up to 3 hosts free, or use Desk for more. Nothing is fetched or stored.

config.description: mcp.json object or text, same as mcp_json

hosts.description: Hostnames, a list, or one host per line

mcp_json.description: mcp.json object. Only each server's url, serverUrl or httpUrl hostname is read.

name: check_mcp_setup
title: Check my MCP setup
